<StyledDropzone
          data-testid="dropzone"
          sx={{
            transition: "all 250ms ease-in-out",
            outline: "none",
          }}
          {...getRootProps()}
          ref={dropzoneRef}
          error={!!error || !!dropzoneError}
        >
          <input
            {...getInputProps()}
            {...(kiosk && {
              type: "file",
              accept: "image/*",
              capture: "environment",
            })}
          />
          {previewFile ? (
            <Box display="flex" overflow="hidden">
              {previewFile?.type === "application/pdf" ? (
                <Box
                  display="flex"
                  width={dropzoneRef?.current?.clientWidth || "100%"}
                  height={450}
                >
                  <object
                    data={previewFile?.preview}
                    type="application/pdf"
                    width="100%"
                  />
                </Box>
              ) : (
                <CardMedia
                  sx={{
                    display: "flex",
                  }}
                  component="img"
                  src={previewFile?.preview}
                />
              )}
            </Box>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Typography variant="body2" color="textSecondary">
                {kiosk ? "Tap to take a photo" : "Drag & drop your files here"}
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="body2" color="textSecondary">
                {`(.jpeg, .jpg, .png, .gif${kiosk ? "" : ", .pdf"})`}
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="body2" color="primary">
                {kiosk ? "Take photo" : "Browse and upload"}
              </Typography>
            </>
          )}
        </StyledDropzone>
        <FormHelperText>{dropzoneError || error?.message}</FormHelperText>
